data.explanation: This is your yearly electricity bill. You used more power than your instalments covered, so you owe €184.36, due within 14 days of the statement date (20 November 2026). From December your monthly instalment also rises to €94.00 to better match your usage. Pay the balance on time to your supplier's account to avoid a reminder or late fee. If you think the usage figure is wrong, contact the billing team listed on the statement before paying. No formal objection procedure is mentioned, but you can raise questions with the supplier directly.
